propositions: Every supported Cloud/DC mutation must route through exactly one typed coordinator/adapter path with no hidden SDK, generic wrapper, _best_effort, or duck-typed fallback reachable from production
Unsupported production actions must fail with a typed provider-neutral error before local or remote effects occur
Cursor, baseline, and binding state must advance only for proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit-unknown work must remain recoverable and never counted as applied
The repair_at_write_boundary call must remain positioned after under-lock staleness validation and before the first remote issue fetch to prevent silent race conditions
Preview, manifest, and logs must preserve existing mutation fields while adding versioned redacted sections for lifecycle, logical attempts, delay budgets, disposition, and retry_not_before
Portable verified-fake Cloud/DC end-to-end tests must cover mixed success, transient recovery, deferral, failure, fuse behavior, create containment, and restart scenarios without external credentials
